header:
New year, new numbers
what changed Jan 1

lines.text: Your Social Security check grows 3.6% this month.
lines.say: Your Social Security check grows three point six percent this month.

lines.text: SSA announced it last October, up from 2.8% for 2026.
lines.say: The Social Security Administration announced it last October, up from two point eight percent for twenty twenty-six.

lines.text: Our math: a $2,000 monthly check becomes $2,072.
lines.say: Our math: a two thousand dollar monthly check becomes two thousand seventy-two dollars.

lines.text: Still working? Social Security tax now covers your first $192,300 of pay.
lines.say: Still working? Social Security tax now covers your first one hundred ninety-two thousand three hundred dollars of pay.

lines.text: Minimum wages rose too. Washington's is $17.73 in 2027, the nation's highest state rate.
lines.say: Minimum wages rose too. Washington's is seventeen seventy-three an hour in twenty twenty-seven, the nation's highest state rate.

lines.text: California rose to $17.40, and Michigan to $15.00.
lines.say: California rose to seventeen forty, and Michigan to fifteen dollars.

lines.text: The federal minimum? Still $7.25, unchanged since 2009.
lines.say: The federal minimum? Still seven twenty-five, unchanged since two thousand nine.

lines.text: Tax brackets and 401(k) limits are tied to inflation too, so the IRS adjusts them yearly.
lines.say: Tax brackets and four oh one K limits are tied to inflation too, so the I R S adjusts them each year.

lines.text: So this month, check your paycheck and your budget against the new numbers.
lines.say: So this month, check your paycheck and your budget against the new numbers.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: What changed Jan 1, 2027: a 3.6% raise and new wage floors
post.ig:
Social Security checks grow 3.6% starting with January 2027 payments.
SSA announced the 3.6% COLA on Oct 14, 2026 (up from 2.8%). Our math: a $2,000 check becomes $2,072.
The Social Security wage cap rose to $192,300 from $184,500.
Minimum wages on Jan 1, 2027: Washington $17.73, California $17.40, Michigan $15.00. Federal: still $7.25 since 2009.
Sources: SSA, WA L&I, California DIR, Michigan LEO, US DOL.
News and education, not financial advice.
